units.one_line: Routes every bus event to a per-E3 context, creates that E3's actors on demand, and tears the context down when the E3 ends.

actors.name: E3Router
actors.role: Subscribes to every bus event, routes each one to its E3 context through RequestRouter, creates contexts lazily, and publishes E3RequestComplete.

actors.name: E3LifecycleCoordinator
actors.role: Durable observer that tracks each E3 stage (Requested, CommitteeFinalized, KeyPublished, and so on); it publishes no events.

consumes.name: every bus event (EventType::All)
Shutdown and EffectsEnabled (broadcast to all contexts)
SyncEffect (reconciles recovered selections, writes checkpoint)
per-E3 events such as E3Requested (create or route to a context)
E3Failed (slashable reasons: teardown after a grace period)
E3RequestComplete (teardown of the context)
E3Requested (stores E3Meta as a dependency)
LIFECYCLE_EVENTS (E3Requested, CommitteeFinalized, CiphertextOutputPublished, E3Failed, and others)
Shutdown (persists the stage map and stops)

state.name: live contexts keyed by E3 id
router recovery checkpoint (contexts, completed set, replay cursors)
per-E3 context snapshot (recipient and dependency keys)
E3Meta per E3 (thresholds, seed, BFV preset, params)

key_types.name: E3Router
key_types.what: Actix actor that owns the per-E3 contexts, the extension list, the event buffer, and the checkpoint store.

key_types.name: E3Context
key_types.what: Per-E3 struct, not an actor: e3_id, recipient Addrs by key, typed dependencies, and its snapshot repository.

key_types.name: E3Extension
key_types.what: Plugin trait: on_event runs on each routed event and may create actors; hydrate rebuilds them after restart.

key_types.name: RequestRouter
key_types.what: Pure routing service that returns a RoutingDecision for an event, with no actix or I/O.

key_types.name: PostForward
key_types.what: Action after forwarding: PublishComplete, ScheduleTeardown (grace), Teardown, or None.

key_types.name: E3Meta
key_types.what: Committee metadata copied from E3Requested: threshold_m, threshold_n, seed, BFV preset, params, error_size.

key_types.name: E3LifecycleService
key_types.what: Pure monotonic stage tracker; observe() returns a LifecycleDecision and freezes a terminal stage.

key_types.name: E3RouterBuilder
key_types.what: Installs extensions and restore inputs, then starts the router and subscribes it to the bus in build().

units.one_line: Chooses E3 committees by ranking operator tickets against the request seed, then tells each node whether it was finalized into one.

actors.name: Sortition
actors.role: Bus subscriber for registry and chain state; ranks tickets for each E3Requested once its seed arrives, and stores finalized committees.

actors.name: CiphernodeSelector
actors.role: Bus subscriber that turns a ranking result into TicketGenerated and a finalized roster into CiphernodeSelected; it also tracks aggregator failover.

CommitteeFinalized (stores the roster and reconciles node jobs)
CommitteeMemberExpelled (buffered until the roster exists, then re-published with party id)
CommitteeMemberExcluded (same buffer and re-publish path)
STATE_EVENTS (registry and chain-state events, for example CiphernodeAdded and TicketBalanceUpdatedAt)
E3Requested (caches E3Meta for the selector)

CommitteeFinalized (publishes CiphernodeSelected when this node is in the roster)

units.one_line: Turns a detected proof fault into a signed accusation, gathers committee votes to a quorum, and emits the verdict for on-chain slashing.

actors.name: AccusationManager
actors.role: Per-E3 actor that runs the accusation quorum: admits accusations and votes, dispatches ZK re-verification, runs vote timers, and publishes outcomes.

actors.name: CommitmentConsistencyChecker
actors.role: Per-E3 actor that caches verified proof outputs, checks cross-circuit commitment links before and after ZK, and publishes violations.

consumes.name: ProofVerificationFailed and ProofVerificationPassed (local results)
ProofFailureAccusation (from a peer: agree, abstain, or re-verify)
AccusationVote (from a peer: counted toward quorum)
ComputeResponse and ComputeRequestError (ZK re-verification results)
CommitmentConsistencyViolation (starts an accusation)
CommitteeMemberExpelled (removes the operator from the voters and its votes)
CommitteeFinalized (starts the AccusationManager for the E3)
CommitmentConsistencyCheckRequested (pre-ZK gate, returns inconsistent parties)
ProofVerificationPassed (cross-circuit check after ZK)
CommitmentRosterSelected (fixes the C4 roster used to map rows)

emits.name: ComputeRequest (ReverifyAccusedProof for forwarded C3a or C3b)

state.name: AccusationVoting service (pending accusations, votes, received proofs)
vote timeout handles keyed by accusation id
saved pending accusations, admitted votes, absolute timeouts, evidence, and accused proofs
verified proof cache keyed by (address, proof type)
commitment checker snapshot repository (written after each change)

key_types.name: AccusationVoting
key_types.what: Plain synchronous quorum service: admits accusations and votes, and returns VoteActions for the actor to run.

key_types.name: accusation_vote_quorum
key_types.what: Maps threshold T and committee size N to H, the honest-party count used as the vote quorum.

key_types.name: ProofFailureAccusation
key_types.what: Signed gossip message: accused party, proof type, data hash, vote window, optional forwarded C3a or C3b payload.

key_types.name: AccusationOutcome
key_types.what: AccusedFaulted, Equivocation, or Inconclusive; only AccusedFaulted proceeds to a slash proposal.

key_types.name: AccusationQuorumReached
key_types.what: Terminal event with accuser, accused, proof type, votes, outcome, and evidence.

key_types.name: CommitmentLink
key_types.what: Trait for one cross-circuit rule: source and target proof types, a scope, and a consistency check.

key_types.name: CommitmentConsistency
key_types.what: Plain service that caches verified outputs, maps C2 rows through the C4 roster, and returns violations.

key_types.name: AccusationManagerExtension
key_types.what: Router extension, not an actor: starts an AccusationManager on CommitteeFinalized, and again on hydrate after restart.

rust_patterns.note: AccusationManager is a thin actix shell around the plain AccusationVoting service.
The envelope handler routes each InterfoldEvent to its typed handler.
Vote timeouts are scheduled with run_later and cancelled through the stored SpawnHandle.
CommitmentConsistency holds its rules as boxed CommitmentLink trait objects.
apply_actions matches each VoteAction that the pure service returns.
A ZK response with no pending re-verification is ignored with an early return.
